summary.text: Luke Rae is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Taylor Crouse.
Rae is a pharmacist who, in a Ballotpedia survey, also described himself as a manager, college instructor and family farm worker.

paragraphs.text: Luke Rae graduated from Mid-Buchanan High School, earned a graduate degree from the University of Missouri, Kansas City in 2016, and earned a second graduate degree from Northern Kentucky University in 2023.
His career experience includes working as a pharmacist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Rae described himself as a husband, father, pharmacist, manager, college instructor and someone who works on his family farm.

He listed three key campaign messages: increasing public education funding and ending taxpayer funding of private school vouchers, getting big money and super PACs out of politics, and a more progressive tax code that protects the middle class.
Rae said his policy interests include education, healthcare, taxes, unions, data centers and money in politics.
